// diagnostic

E0772

This call to {callee} matches more than one callable body

What

This call to {callee} matches more than one callable body

Why

The call's bare arguments and labels bind to multiple candidate signatures, so named arguments are required to deconflict them

Fix

Name the arguments to choose one candidate: {rewrite}

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0772: tests/ui/ambiguous_call_e0772.stderr.

Error [jet.DuplicateDefinition]: Method `put` is defined twice on `Store`
  --> tests/ui/ambiguous_call_e0772.jet:8:8
    |
  8 |     fn put(self, key: String, id: String) -> String { "{key} = {id}" }
    |        ^^^
 Why: Each method name may appear only once on a type
 Fix: Rename or remove one of the definitions
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0105

Error [jet.AmbiguousCall]: This call to `put` matches more than one callable body
  --> tests/ui/ambiguous_call_e0772.jet:18:17
    |
 18 |     print(store.put("name", "text"))
    |                 ^^^
 Why: The overload set has no unique inferred method
 Fix: Add labels or type arguments that select one method
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0772
